# LAMP TIK (lamptik.online)

> Free, watermark-free HD video downloader for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook and YouTube. No account, no app, zero server storage, true H.264 hardware-verified streams.

## Core free tools
- [TikTok Video Downloader (HD MP4 + MP3)](https://www.lamptik.online/): paste any tiktok.com / vt.tiktok.com / vm.tiktok.com link, get the clean hdplay/play H.264 stream, no watermark.
- [Instagram Reels Downloader](https://www.lamptik.online/instagram-reels-downloader): public reels/posts/IGTV via embed + OG fallback, H.264 verified.
- [Facebook Video Downloader](https://www.lamptik.online/facebook-video-downloader): reels/watch/fb.watch/share links via desktop+mobile+plugin+mbasic waterfall.
- [YouTube Downloader (1080p HD)](https://www.lamptik.online/youtube-downloader): watch/shorts/youtu.be links, 1080p/720p/360p MP4 + MP3 — free, no app required.
- [Download the LAMP TIK App](https://www.lamptik.online/app-download): native Android app (no store) plus installable web app for iPhone/iPad & PC.

## API health & trust
- Health: `GET https://www.lamptik.online/api/health` (200 OK JSON)
- Resolver: `POST https://www.lamptik.online/api/fetch` { url } — 3-tier waterfall per platform, 4.5s per-provider timeout, 60s circuit-breaker.
- Zero server storage. Zero watermarks. H.264/AAC verified by MP4 probe. DMCA: support@lamptik.online.
